declared.reason: Removes Result.DriftFindingsTruncated and the truncation that set it. The runner could never set it: DecodeDrift admits each category of the closed drift vocabulary at most once, the vocabulary is smaller than the 64 summaries truncation needed, and omitempty never wrote a false flag. Every frame a runner writes is byte for byte the frame it wrote before, so a manager on either side of the change reads the other's frames as it did.
